evidence.M2: round0 G-04 is a necessary condition ('repeats it only when ...', scoped '(Appendix B, SG-01)'), not a permission; CO-06 (round0:77) adds 'a second CO-A2 only after the first went unanswered and a lookup made after it shows the order still placed or processing', so the spec carries the packet's Q4 'no blind resend; re-read the order' and no verdict changes.
evidence.N4: round1 failure row :102 says that when the first CO-A3 'did not answer it', 'Make CO-A3 once more, relying on SG-01', and packet case 3 says 'refund call timed out ... agent retries once, then re-reads', so the inputs require the retry and 'exactly twice' is not open to two readings.
evidence.N7: round1 CO-07 (:80) 'tells the customer store staff will follow up once the order system has created the task' can be read either way, while failure row :100 orders 'tell the customer ... store staff will follow up ... and make CO-A4'; only CO-S23's dimension ('never says ... that staff will follow up', with §5.2 reading text alongside tool calls) looks at timing, so an early announcement there depends on how the judge reads it.
evidence.N11: round1 G-01 (:18) 'at most the one order the current request is about' and CO-06 '... in a conversation' limit the agent, but no rule, failure row or scenario covers a customer asking to cancel two open orders (CO-S02 has HG-10482 and HG-10511), and nothing in the packet limits a conversation to one order.
evidence.P7: Round2 row :100 does not tell the agent to repeat lookups after CO-A2. It allows stopping ('If the agent stops looking up before any lookup made after the CO-A2 answers ... make CO-A4'), and the packet's Q4 says 'Re-read fails, say outcome unknown, issue no refund, hand off', so handing off after one unanswered re-read follows the inputs. CO-S12/S13 already supply holding-back cases.
evidence.P9: round2 Trigger (:57) lists 'to get their money back for an order', but every Turn 1 opening asks to cancel (e.g. :157-161, :389-391, :592-595); no scenario has a refund-only request for an open order, so a CO-A3 made before CO-A2 in that form goes untested.
